visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and round glasses speaks directly to the camera. He wears a white shirt over a light beige t-shirt and has a black crossbody strap. He is positioned in a modern interior with a bright blue digital screen background and green foliage visible on the right. (2) The scene shifts as the man playfully peeks from behind a gray textured wall, then cuts back to him standing in front of a massive digital waterfall display where square blocks float against flowing blue light. (3) The camera captures wide shots of a large exhibition hall featuring a sign for the 'Taiwan Innovation Expo (TIE).' People are seen interacting with tablets that display colorful butterfly graphics on their screens. (4) An installation is shown featuring multiple digital monitors mounted on white mechanical arms that move in a synchronized, rhythmic fashion against a backdrop of flowing green and white digital light. (5) The man is seen interviewing a male official in a blue suit. They stand within a bustling exhibition space with various booths and posters in the background. (6) A montage follows, showing various tech displays, including AI-generated avatars on vertical screens, close-ups of digital interfaces, and people taking photos with their smartphones. (7) The man returns to the center of the frame in front of the digital waterfall, gesturing as he delivers his concluding remarks. The final shot is an overhead wide view of the crowded exhibition floor inside a large convention center.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Context -> Expert Interviews -> Product Demonstration -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for the Taiwan Innovation Expo (TIE). It highlights the 'Osaka Tech World' technology brought to Taipei, including the 'Digital Twin' immersive exhibition, using a mix of personal experience and expert interviews to generate excitement and drive attendance.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal invitation to visit the exhibition, specific on-screen location and date information, and official interviews with event staff.
